context_entries_shape_check.name: context_entries_shape_check
context_entries_shape_check.value:
(
        ("context_entries"."kind" = 'file' AND "context_entries"."body" IS NOT NULL AND "context_entries"."fact_type" IS NULL AND "context_entries"."fact_value" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("context_entries"."kind" = 'fact' AND "context_entries"."body" IS NULL AND "context_entries"."fact_type" IN (
          'identity','decision','policy','constraint','preference','relationship','metric','reference','other'
        ) AND jsonb_typeof("context_entries"."fact_value") IN ('string','number','boolean'))
      )

evidence_assessments_target_check.name: evidence_assessments_target_check
evidence_assessments_target_check.value: (("evidence_assessments"."target_type" IN ('task_create','project_create','context_create') AND "evidence_assessments"."target_id" IS NULL AND "evidence_assessments"."target_version" IS NULL) OR ("evidence_assessments"."target_type" IN ('task','project','context') AND "evidence_assessments"."target_id" IS NOT NULL AND "evidence_assessments"."target_version" IS NOT NULL))

inference_budgets_max_check.name: inference_budgets_max_check
inference_budgets_max_check.value: "inference_budgets"."max_calls">0 AND "inference_budgets"."max_input_tokens">0 AND "inference_budgets"."max_output_tokens">0 AND ("inference_budgets"."max_usd" IS NULL OR "inference_budgets"."max_usd">0)

model_calls_nonnegative_check.name: model_calls_nonnegative_check
model_calls_nonnegative_check.value: "model_calls"."reserved_input_tokens">=0 AND "model_calls"."reserved_output_tokens">=0 AND "model_calls"."reserved_usd">=0 AND ("model_calls"."input_tokens" IS NULL OR "model_calls"."input_tokens">=0) AND ("model_calls"."output_tokens" IS NULL OR "model_calls"."output_tokens">=0) AND ("model_calls"."cached_input_tokens" IS NULL OR "model_calls"."cached_input_tokens">=0) AND ("model_calls"."cost_usd" IS NULL OR "model_calls"."cost_usd">=0)

observation_dispositions_processing_chec.name: observation_dispositions_processing_check
observation_dispositions_processing_chec.value: "observation_dispositions"."state" <> 'processing' OR ("observation_dispositions"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "observation_dispositions"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL)
